weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. If a penalty inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and/or a negative status effect (preventing counterattacks or restricting movement) is active on foe, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack and foe cannot.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

b.d: At start of turn, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, inflicts Atk/Spd-6 on foe on the enemy team with the lowest Res through its next action.

At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-7 and 【Guard】 on foes on the enemy team with the lowest Res and any foe within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
【Guard】
Inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on unit per attack during combat through its next action. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Atk-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, if unit is within 4 spaces of a foe, inflicts Atk/Def-6 on nearest foes through their next actions and grants Atk/Def+6 to unit for 1 turn.
Inflicts Atk-3 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Inflicts Atk-5 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Inflicts Atk-7 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
